hero.description: Hi, I'm Karan Patel — a front end engineer specializing in Angular, React, Ionic and TypeScript. I build scalable, performant web applications that users love.

headline: Building the future,
one component at a time.
paragraphs: I'm a passionate software engineer with over 5 years of experience crafting digital products that make a difference. My journey started with a curiosity for how things work on the web, and it has evolved into a deep expertise in modern frontend technologies.

I specialize in Angular, React, Ionic, and TypeScript, building everything from sleek landing pages to complex enterprise applications. My approach combines technical excellence with a keen eye for design and user experience.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, building projects and asking questions.
about.quote: “My mission is to create digital experiences that are not just functional, but truly delightful — products that users love to use and developers love to maintain.”

experiments.name: Angular Dynamic Form
experiments.description: Dynamic forms are built using Reactive Forms (FormGroup, FormControl, and FormArray) or the Signals-based form system to generate form controls at runtime based on a metadata object or JSON configuration. This eliminates hardcoded HTML and is perfect for metadata-driven schemas, questionnaires, or flexible admin panels.

experience.description: Building frontend web apps for a suite of gambling products. Working on Ionic Components. Working mostly on Angular Ionic Code to create, manage and debug applications
Developed Front-End applications from the legacy applications using their new shared components. Hands on working with Bootstrap and CSS3 Media Queries to support for Responsive Web Design

testimonials.quote: Karan worked with me during a career transition to help develop my Resume and overall strategy to attract the best companies possible. He sat down with me to understand my background in detail and found creative ways to relate it back to the companies I am interested in working for. At last, with the help of Karan, I got placed in my dream job. Moreover, his expertise in a developer field is only matched by his wit, which helps make every interaction with him a glowing experience. If you're looking for an expert in web developing (don't call him a guru, he might laugh in your face) then look no further than Mr. Patel.
testimonials.author: Divyang

testimonials.quote: He is the person in your team who knows how to follow before leading. I have worked with him and working with him was seamless. Curious, Helping, and learning new things are his most important qualities. I would recommend him for almost any sort of work that needs leading the team. He is a great team leader to work with.
